newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds ended virtually unchanged in a dull session mostly spent tracking Bunds. The cash 10-year spread over Bunds was glued to 120 bps.
Dealers said worrying signs were coming from the Italian market, where Btps were falling and the Bank of Italy was reported to have bought lira for marks.
"It could affect our market as well," one dealer said.

Spain's debt market shrugged off news the government intends to present a three-year plan in May to guarantee fiscal discipline after 1997. "Of course it's good news but on a day as boring as today the market did not react," a dealer said.
The yield curve, after having steepened a bit in the morning, ended unchanged.
At the Treasury action of six-month bills on Wednesday, dealers expect the yield unchanged at around 5.31 percent.
